rca_of_issue: Expo Modules Core SDK 54 changed the sync `Function` builder so its lambda return-type infers as Any? (to allow returning JSON-compatible values to JS). Kotlin overload resolution then required EVERY exit path of the lambda body to evaluate to Any?, including the implicit final `Unit` from a `.apply()` or `.startActivity(...)` call. Three void Function blocks (openNotificationAccessSettings, setIngestConfig, setEnabled) had: (a) early-exit `return@Function` with no value (= Unit), and (b) a final void expression. Both were Unit, hence the compile error 'Return type mismatch: expected Any?, actual Unit'. Fix: return `null` explicitly on every exit (early or terminal). Verified via static read — no other lambdas affected.
